prompts.tape: seedance_2.0_mini|4|A shot from an over-the-top 1980s action movie, filmed on 35 mm and seen on a worn VHS tape: heavy film grain, soft focus, tape tracking lines and colour bleed, anamorphic lens flares, smoke, hard backlight in magenta and cyan neon, wet streets. The camera pushes fast into the glowing screen.

The shot in {{res:8d25cc18-d577-4d8a-9df0-415cc1af71ea}}, made again with one more fighter: the same six video game fighters walk side by side towards the camera in slow motion out of a wall of fire and exploding arcade machines, and a seventh walks with them at the right end of the row, next to the man with the television head: the vampire of {{res:64e5abc3-51f4-4020-ab4c-b9e31882e950}} and {{res:d842882b-3125-4880-ae6f-681ae0c744aa}}, a tall pale glam-rock vampire with a towering mane of teased black hair, purple eye shadow and fangs, a black leather jacket with silver spikes, leopard-print trousers, silver boots and purple boxing gloves. All seven are fully in the picture from head to foot, none hidden behind another. Sparks rain down, their coats and hair blow in the blast.
